_doc: Document-age indicators (days between publication date and answer time, SGT). They describe how old a report is, not whether its forecasts remain valid. 'Date uncertain' applies whenever date confidence is low or the date conflicts.

daily.label: Daily reports (Daily Treasury Outlook, Daily Market Outlook, Daily Credit Snapshot)

weekly.label: Weekly reports (FX Weekly, Weekly Macro View, Credit Week in Brief, Week in Review, Sustainability Weekly)

thematic.label: Thematic / event notes (Interest Rates Focus, Regional Focus, commodities, auction previews, central-bank reviews)

monthly.label: Monthly / outlook reports (monthlies, half-year outlooks, compendia)
